The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERAL
1A- G 42778 - 359 (09/2024) This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
Appointment & c., by the President

IT is hereby notified that the Honourable President, in terms of Article 51(1)(a) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, has appointed Mr. G. P. Saputhanthri, as the Secretary to the Prime Minister, with effect from September 24, 2024.
By Order of the Honourable President,
Dr. N.S. Kumanayake, Secretary to the President.
Presidential Secretariat,Colombo 01,September 27, 2024.

IT is hereby notified that the Honourable President, in terms of Article 51(2)(a) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, has appointed Mr. W. M. D. J. Fernando, as the Secretary to the Cabinet of Ministers, with effect from September 24, 2024.
By Order of the Honourable President,
Dr. N.S. Kumanayake, Secretary to the President.
Presidential Secretariat,Colombo 01,September 27, 2024.
